hooks.text: The narwhal's famous unicorn horn is actually an erupted tooth.
Did you know the narwhal's horn is packed with millions of nerve endings?
This whale grows a three-meter tooth straight through its jaw.

title: The Strange Truth About the Narwhal Tusk
description: Discover why the narwhal's iconic spiral tusk is actually an inside-out tooth packed with millions of nerve endings.

beats.text: Narwhals have no functional chewing teeth at all and swallow their deep-sea prey whole.

beats.text: Instead of eating with it, the male whale channels dental energy into a colossal upper left canine.

beats.text: This massive tusk can reach lengths of 1.5 to 3 meters in a counterclockwise spiral.

beats.text: Biologists discovered the giant external tooth is actually packed with millions of microscopic nerve endings.
beats.visual: Narwhal swimming underwater in clear Arctic water

beats.text: Because female narwhals usually lack tusks and still outlive males, the tusk is not needed for basic survival.
